name: LethAL R136 ArmK Count Probe
brief: R136 arm K: what does Count() actually return inside OnInsert for an uncommitted row in the same transaction?
description: Throwaway probe, not for production use. Measures the arm K premise the pre-commitment judged cosmetic: does Count() inside a table's own OnInsert see 0 on both of two back-to-back Insert(true) calls in one transaction, or does it see the first row (0 then 1)?
